description: This file defines data structures and functions for constructing and manipulating the outline of Ginkgo test specifications, including parsing AST nodes to identify test containers and specs, and propagating focus/pending properties within the test outline.

classes.name: ginkgoMetadata
classes.description: Holds information about a test or container, including name, text, position, and status flags.

classes.name: ginkgoNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the test outline tree, including metadata and child nodes.

methods.name: PreOrder
methods.description: Traverses the tree in pre-order, applying a function to each node.

methods.name: PostOrder
methods.description: Traverses the tree in post-order, applying a function to each node.

methods.name: Walk
methods.description: Traverses the tree with pre- and post- functions.

methods.name: PropagateInheritedProperties
methods.description: Propagates Pending and Focused flags down the tree.

methods.name: BackpropagateUnfocus
methods.description: Unfocuses nodes in the tree based on nested focus rules.

methods.name: ginkgoNodeFromCallExpr
methods.description: Creates a ginkgoNode from an AST call expression, identifying test containers/specs.

methods.name: packageAndIdentNamesFromCallExpr
methods.description: Extracts package and identifier names from a call expression.

methods.name: absoluteOffsetsForNode
methods.description: Calculates absolute start and end offsets for an AST node.

methods.name: textOrAltFromCallExpr
methods.description: Derives the text description from a call expression or returns an alternative.

methods.name: textFromCallExpr
methods.description: Extracts the text argument from a call expression.

methods.name: labelFromCallExpr
methods.description: Extracts label strings from a call expression.

methods.name: extractLabels
methods.description: Extracts label strings from label call expressions.

methods.name: pendingFromCallExpr
methods.description: Determines if a call expression marks a test/spec as pending.
